description: This class includes the manufacture of musical instruments of all kinds.
includes: manufacture of string instruments: guitars, violins, harps, banjos, mandolins
manufacture of keyboard string instruments: pianos, harpsichords, clavichords
manufacture of keyboard pipe organs, harmoniums
manufacture of accordions and similar instruments
manufacture of wind instruments: trumpets, trombones, flutes, clarinets, saxophones
manufacture of percussion musical instruments: drums, xylophones, cymbals
manufacture of electronic musical instruments: electronic keyboards, synthesizers
manufacture of musical boxes, fairground organs, calliopes
manufacture of instrument parts and accessories: metronomes, tuning forks, pitch pipes, music stands, music racks, conducting batons
excludes: manufacture of toy musical instruments, see 3240
